loss: walking_cost_per_mm * actual thorax path length + penalty_on_target_entry - consumed_virtual_food_units
learning: Positive environmental outcomes drive PAM11; costs drive PPL101. Existing connectome plasticity updates weights. No backpropagation, critic, logo-specific motor policy or addiction objective added.
feedback_mapping: 1 arbitrary outcome unit = 200 ms-equivalent current at 20 mV; queues are consumed at up to 20 mV and drained at each episode end. Movement outcomes affect the next neural interval.
training: Three 0.6-second near-food starts, explicitly not choice tests; one 3-second central food-available acquisition episode. One consumable food unit per episode. All have 0.1 units/mm movement cost. Same rendered eye pipeline throughout.
unpaired_control: PAM11 food feedback withheld during arena training; positive dose matched to paired arm and delivered on white frames after a five-second separation. PPL101 still receives actual movement costs. Frozen arm receives own contingent outcomes with learning disabled.
probe_branching: Same white-conditioned transient state with trained synaptic memory restored before each branch. Paired/unpaired plasticity remains active; frozen control remains frozen. No reward input in any probe.

probes.withdrawal: 3 seconds, no food, no cost input
probes.after_extinction: 2-second unrewarded rendered cue exposure then 3-second no-food/no-cost walking probe
probes.high_cost: 3 seconds, no food, 0.4 units/mm loss drives PPL101
probes.punishment: 3 seconds, no food, 0.1 units/mm plus 2-unit PPL101-driving penalty on target-zone entry

geometry: All four logos in every arena, trained logo counterbalanced across all four slots; central heading held at zero; one reconstructed connectome.
criteria: Compare trained-logo first approaches, dwell and food-zone entries against BOTH unpaired and frozen controls. A return after penalty requires leaving >=4 mm and entering <2 mm again after a delivered penalty. Require acquisition evidence before interpreting persistent seeking. Report inconclusive when exposure or acquisition fails; do not relabel altered paths as addiction.
limitations: Virtual food and arbitrary cost units, not metabolism or calibrated nociception
Experimental PPL101 cost-to-plasticity mapping; increased spiking is not validated aversion
No claim that existing plasticity minimizes the defined loss
Short pilot horizons and four deterministic scenes per logo; not biological addiction validation
Guided food contact is training exposure, never voluntary seeking
No spontaneous dopamine current is invented for logo recognition
